prompt: A single decisive telekinetic four-sword attack toward screen right. She braces briefly, snaps one open palm forward, and all four hovering swords pivot to point right and thrust forward in a coordinated explosive stabbing volley. A short sharp golden motion streak emphasizes the heavy impact. Exactly four separate swords remain visible, never fuse or multiply. Her body stays planted with a small forward lean, feet at their original baseline, no zoom or change in size. Then all four swords retract and rotate upright into their starting formation, two ahead and two behind, and she returns fully to her original relaxed ready pose. Clear anticipation, extremely fast strike, brief follow-through, complete recovery.
